overview.title: Start here
overview.body:
Demo data for Northwind Ltd, a fictional software and professional-services company with three offices (HQ – Riverside, Office – Harbour, Office – Northgate).

Certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 by Example Certification Body.

Each section carries its own short note.

controls.title: Statement of Applicability
controls.body: 93 Annex A controls, all applicable. Partial implementations are recorded as exceptions rather than hidden.

ncs.title: Nonconformities
ncs.body: Findings from the demo certification audit. All minor or observation; no majors.

risks.title: Risk register
risks.body: 5x5 method, risk level = likelihood x consequence. Reviewed by top management every six months.

esg.title: ESG
esg.body: ESG follows an annual reporting cycle. Scope 3 emissions (travel, cloud hosting, hardware) are the weak spot.

vendors.title: Suppliers
vendors.body: Suppliers are classified Critical, Important or Non-Critical and evaluated annually.

people.title: People and training
people.body: Roles, competence and mandate are defined per role. Awareness training completion is tracked in the learning platform.

sites.title: Sites and offices
sites.body: Three offices under one certificate. Production runs with a cloud hosting provider, so an office outage does not affect customers.

environment.title: Environment (ISO 14001)
environment.body: Aspect assessment is being harmonised across offices; IT asset disposal registers are still to be created.

policies.title: Policies and standards
policies.body: Policies are approved by the COO; changes are recorded in the change register.

incidents.title: Incidents and changes
incidents.body: One register holds incidents, changes and regulatory notification deadlines.

audits.title: Audit programme
audits.body: The internal audit programme covers all three standards; an external consultant audits the compliance function for independence.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.body: Evidence that the SoA is honest: nothing is marked compliant when it is not.

evidence.title: Evidence library
evidence.body: Always open the live file listed in the link register, not a mailed copy.

opsproc.title: Processes
opsproc.body: Documented processes supporting Annex A 5.37 and ISO 9001 clause 4.4.

core.title: IMS Core (clauses 4–10)
core.body: Management-system requirements shared by all three standards.

soa.title: Only ISO 27001 has a Statement of Applicability
soa.body: The SoA is required by ISO/IEC 27001 clause 6.1.3 d). ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 use other registers for the equivalent role.

soa.title: Approve every version
soa.body: Clause 7.5.2 requires documented information to be approved. Record the approver for each version.

soa.title: Client view is a display filter, not a control
soa.body: Client view hides internal fields on screen only. Use Export for anything that leaves the organisation.
